comparison.objective: Candidate installs and fastens a rack rail; record measures exactly two leveled scoops of powdered formula into a bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs long rigid-part manipulation and mechanical engagement; record performs granular scooping, strike-off leveling, controlled transfer, and exact dosing.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks prong and screw retention; record requires two bar-leveled scoops within a mass window and fails on unlevelled transfer, overdose, spill, or unfinished tool handling.
comparison.reason: Granular metering and irreversible dosing are unrelated to structural rack installation. Candidate has no powder-like mass criterion; its missing mechanical thresholds do not imply overlap.
